values.summary: Encode lifecycle and correction authorization as a pure exhaustive transition kernel generated from the frozen capability matrix, including exact recovery invalidation, stale CAS, ownership, terminal, and cleanup predicates.

steps.action: Generate the complete state/command transition-and-correction table from the V3-01 capability matrix and reject unmapped pairs.
Implement pure transition inputs/results with topology-only ownership, generation/digest CAS, review staleness, publication, terminal, and cleanup predicates.
Implement review recover only from reviewed/published/merge_ready to implemented with complete atomic invalidation; reject merged/closed_out.
Prove every supported invalidation/recovery state has a concrete reachable typed correction or terminal disposition and no abstract operator sink.
Run exhaustive table, mutation/property, stale-CAS, correction invalidation, dead-end reachability, and cleanup-eligibility tests with no adapters.
Retain generated-table parity and stop if ambient I/O or claim/lease/heartbeat authority reappears.
Release property-test fixtures and verify the pure kernel created no files, processes, network calls, claims, leases, or hidden ownership state.

invariants: Issue V3-07 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim
No mutation outside exact owned paths
risks: A passing artifact could overstate production, legal, or release authority.
Path or external-account overlap could collide with another active issue.
Evidence could become stale if it is not tied to exact revisions and producer outcomes.
stop_conditions: A transition needs ambient I/O, an unknown state falls through, or claims, leases, heartbeats, or protected-path ledgers reappear as authority.
